title: OmniStream custom domain support (ommistream.net) - frontend allowlist + docs + config guidance

requirements.summary: Add IC custom-domain allowlist static asset for ommistream.net so the assets canister can serve the app on the custom domain.
acceptanceCriteria: A static file exists at frontend/public/.well-known/ic-domains (exact path, no extension).
The file content includes the domain "ommistream.net" on its own line.
The file content includes the domain "www.ommistream.net" on its own line.
After deploying the frontend assets canister to mainnet, fetching https://<FRONTEND_ASSETS_CANISTER_ID>.icp0.io/.well-known/ic-domains returns the expected domain list (via browser or curl).

file_operations.description: Create the Internet Computer custom-domain allowlist file for the frontend assets canister, containing exactly two lines: 'ommistream.net' and 'www.ommistream.net'.

requirements.summary: Document custom domain setup for ommistream.net (DNS + repo steps) in the mainnet deployment guide.
acceptanceCriteria: frontend/docs/ic-mainnet-deployment.md contains a clearly titled section for custom domain setup (ommistream.net).
The doc explains that the custom domain points to the frontend assets canister (not the backend canister).
The doc describes how to obtain the frontend assets canister ID after deployment and how to form the canister URL using icp0.io.
The doc includes explicit examples of correct hash-routing URLs (e.g., https://ommistream.net/#/ , https://ommistream.net/#/watch/<title>).
The doc includes explicit DNS instructions (record type and target) expressed without assuming a specific registrar UI, and indicates that DNS propagation can take time.
The doc explicitly states that this repo/code change cannot perform the real-world DNS update automatically.

file_operations.description: Add a dedicated, clearly titled section describing how to configure the custom domain ommistream.net to point to the *frontend assets canister*, including: DNS record types/targets (registrar-agnostic), steps to deploy and verify frontend/public/.well-known/ic-domains, how to retrieve the frontend assets canister ID and form the icp0.io URL, explicit hash-routing URL examples, propagation timing notes, and an explicit statement that DNS changes cannot be performed by this repo automatically.

requirements.summary: Update frontend environment example to include Internet Identity derivation origin recommendation for the ommistream.net custom domain.
acceptanceCriteria: frontend/.env.example includes an uncommented or clearly documented example line showing II_DERIVATION_ORIGIN=https://ommistream.net (or an explicit instruction to set it to that value when using the custom domain).
The added/updated comments explain, in English, that II_DERIVATION_ORIGIN is relevant when using a custom domain so user principals remain consistent across domains.

file_operations.description: Update the Internet Identity configuration section to include an example (or clearly documented instruction) setting II_DERIVATION_ORIGIN=https://ommistream.net for custom-domain usage, and explain that it helps keep principals consistent across domains.

requirements.summary: Improve backend-unavailable banner guidance to mention both icp0.io canister URLs and the ommistream.net custom domain, including misconfiguration hints.
acceptanceCriteria: frontend/src/components/BackendUnavailableBanner.tsx displays English guidance that includes both (1) the current icp0.io hostname when applicable and (2) a mention of https://ommistream.net as the intended custom domain.
If the current hostname is not an icp0.io domain, the banner text includes a clear suggestion to try the icp0.io canister URL as a fallback and to verify custom-domain configuration.
All user-facing text added/changed is in English.

file_operations.description: Adjust the banner copy and URL guidance logic to: (a) mention https://ommistream.net as the intended custom domain, (b) when running on an icp0.io hostname, show that current icp0.io canister URL as a valid access path, and (c) when not on icp0.io, suggest trying the icp0.io canister URL format as a fallback and explicitly warn that a misconfigured custom domain/DNS can cause access failures (English text only).
